# Rabaska OS

> French-language operating system for used and refurbished computers. Delivered preinstalled with the machine — no public download.

## Pages

- [Home (FR)](https://rabaskaos.com/) : desktop tour, accessibility at first boot, system, technical, benefits and limits
- [Home (EN)](https://rabaskaos.com/en/) : English mirror of the home page
- [Rights (FR)](https://rabaskaos.com/droits.html) : usage rights, Linux base licences, trademarks
- [Rights (EN)](https://rabaskaos.com/en/rights.html) : English mirror of the rights page

## Contact

- Email: spmorin.mrservices@gmail.com

## Notes

- Content in French (fr-CA) and English (en)
- No public ISO, no installer to download
- Accessibility: four questions at first power-on (style, size, colours, pace), reversible afterward
